verdict.rationale: monday.com documents an admin dashboard where admins can 'audit every action' that each AI agent takes across the org. That is a first-party audit capability, but it is limited to agent actions, not a general workspace-wide log of human user and admin actions. The developer-platform 'logs' feature is app infrastructure and is not credited. Missing for 10: an audit log covering all user/admin actions across the workspace, details on log contents, filtering and retention, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can review an admin audit log of actions taken across the workspace

citations.quote: Scope each agent's board access from the admin, audit every action it takes, and track AI credit spend across the whole org — all from one dashboard.
